prose: The Guardian reports on previously unreported US law enforcement and intelligence documents showing that since 2021 the FBI, DHS and NYPD have treated AI as both a tool and a target of would-be terrorists. One example is the May 2025 Palm Springs fertility clinic car bombing, where the suspect used a generative AI tool that failed to catch his request for bomb-making instructions. The documents also warn about anti-AI extremist threats. Basis: the opening of the article.
highlights: Documents show agencies see AI as a facilitator of violent extremism and a target of it.
Palm Springs 2025 bombing involved an AI tool that missed a bomb-making request.
